latest_delivery.message:
The Hyperlink.OnTapped implementation is incorrect. The Tapped() method currently calls both OnTapped() and openURL(). According to Target 6 requirements, OnTapped should override the URL-opening behavior when set, not complement it. The code should be:

if hl.OnTapped != nil {
    hl.OnTapped()
    return
}
hl.openURL()

This way OnTapped replaces the default behavior instead of running alongside it.
